name: print-social-infographic-quadrant-color-block-features
title: Four-quadrant color-block social features infographic
whatItIs: A four-quadrant infographic (yellow, magenta, navy, pink) each dedicated to a different feature theme (social features, feed, mobile features, follow/games) with flat illustrated hands, devices and connector dotted lines.
whatItMeans: Dividing a feature list into four solid-color quadrants lets a dense feature set be organized spatially by category, so a viewer can jump straight to the section they need.
techniques: divide a page into hard-edged solid-color quadrants, one per topic
illustrate a raised hand or arm reaching into the frame to add human energy to flat icons
connect related icons with dotted paths within each quadrant to show relationships

vocabulary.definition: a design technique dividing a layout into solid blocks of contrasting flat color
